value.rationale: The explicit all-capacity and all-urn-count phase diagram distinguishes three non-equivalent finite-sample shape properties at the earliest genuinely two-rejection horizon. It identifies the exact first failure of independent-Bernoulli decomposability, a single exceptional model, and a sharp ordinary log-concavity transition at 14/15 urns for capacity two; these are structurally relevant limitations on extending capacity-one occupancy concentration principles.
